## Log and notify
Builds one flat row from the normalized order, upserts it into the Orders sheet keyed by order number so a retried call updates the same row instead of duplicating it, then emails the owner a plain-text summary.

nodes.name: Select low-stock variants
nodes.notes: Why Code: parses the GraphQL response, de-duplicates variants, and fails loudly on API errors

parameters.content:
## Stock check
Reads the ordered variants' current stock and brew method from Shopify, flags any that fell below the configured threshold, and emails the owner one alert per order. No per-request timeout on this node (NOTE below); the GraphQL node retries throttling instead of failing outright, since Shopify returns throttling as a 200 response with an errors array rather than an HTTP error.

NOTE: the GraphQL node has no per-request timeout option, so a hung Shopify response blocks this execution until n8n's own default times it out. Ceiling: a slow but responding Shopify API is not bounded here. Upgrade path: switch to the HTTP Request node with options.timeout plus an explicit errors check, trading the GraphQL node's built-in NodeApiError-on-errors behavior for a manual one.
